run_GPT_model: run the GPT model forward pass with token indices and optional targets for loss computation
build_GPTConfig: build a GPTConfig dataclass to set block_size, vocab_size, n_layer, n_head, and n_embd hyperparameters
create_DistributedDataLoader: create a DistributedDataLoader to load binary token shards across multiple DDP processes for training
